newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-CAIRNS FINED HALF OF MATCH FEE FOR SHOWING DISSENT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CAIRNS FINED HALF OF MATCH FEE FOR SHOWING DISSENT.

text.p: New Zealand strike bowler Chris Cairns was fined 50 percent of his match fee on Saturday for disputing an umpiring decision during the third day of the second test against Pakistan.
Match referee Cammie Smith said in a statement Cairns had been penalised for breaching the players' code of conduct.
Cairns punched the air in disbelief after Pakistani umpire Javed Akhtar had turned down his vociferous leg before appeal against Salim Malik.
Pakistan batsman Ejaz Ahmed was fined half his match fee on Friday for waving his bat at Akhtar to indicate that he had hit the ball after being given out lbw.
